Dr. Maxwell McLaughlin graduated from Palmer College of Chiropractic and is a licensed Chiropractor who currently practices in Metro West, Orlando, FL. This channel was created with the aim of providing a soothing and comfortable environment while performing chiropractic services along with educational purposes. Hope you enjoy the contents and hopefully you can visit us and experience all that we have to offer! #chirotothemax 
🟢We are located at 6996 Piazza Grande ave, suite 217, Orlando, FL 32835
🟢Open 7days a week by appointment, Same-day appointment available
🟢TEXT (321) 710-7736 to book your appointment today. (Accepting New patients)
DISCLAIMER:  THE VIDEOS CONTAINED ON THIS CHANNEL, OR ANY OTHER CTTM SOCIAL MEDIA PLATFORMS, ARE FOR ENTERTAINMENT AND EDUCATIONAL PURPOSES ONLY.  THE TECHNIQUES SHOWN IN THE VIDEOS ARE NOT TO BE USED OR ATTEMPTED BY ANYONE OTHER THAN A LICENSED MEDICAL PROFESSIONAL.
